cost.trigger: The user used Rainstorm Deluge (Set-Up) as their last Action.

actions.description:
Trigger: The user used Rainstorm Deluge (Set-Up) as their last Action.

Effect: The user freely Moves up to the Movement Score of their choice before attacking with this Attack.

actions.name: Rainstorm Deluge (Set-Up)
actions.description: Effect: The user gains @Affliction[invisible 2], and ends their Activation. If Rainy Weather is present or the user is affected by Flooded Terrain when this Attack is declared, the user may use Rainstorm Deluge (Resolution) as a Free Action upon resolving this Attack. On resolution, Rainy Weather is set for 3 Rounds.
